name: Venice After Dark
source:
In this atmospheric mix of point-and-click adventure and visual novel, you explore an unusually complex Venice through the eyes of Aiko, an introverted programmer, and Thea, a super-clever but sometimes quirky AI.

Complex puzzles, sensory illusions, and moral decisions challenge you. Reality and dreams, past and present begin to blur—and with them the question of what it actually means to be human.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933960/Venice_After_Dark/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这款点击式冒险和视觉小说的氛围中，你将通过内向的程序员Aiko和超级聪明但有时古怪的人工智能Thea的眼睛探索异常复杂的威尼斯。

复杂的谜题、感官错觉和道德决策对你构成挑战。现实与梦想、过去与现在开始变得模糊——随之而来的问题是，作为人类到底意味着什么。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933960/Venice_After_Dark/]Steam[/url]]
